integrity: The explicit all-length proof and standalone program are included. All assertions are same-model reviewed, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Incoming directed radius two on the degree-two ternary Kautz shift family, n >= 3; does not extend to arbitrary degree, undirected distance, simultaneous fault identification or classification of all optimal codes. Finite computation only corroborates the proof. Priority may be affected by unindexed earlier literature.
title: Optimal two-step identification of ternary Kautz shift networks
